rules.condition: Free natural language in new production prompt with no outer sceneJson

rules.behavior: Parsed object treated as raw Scene plan; not a new prompt version. Backend/duration validation rejects incomplete objects.

rules.condition: Requests such as reference quality, detailed terrain, bright frontier, moving army, camera follow
rules.behavior: Not a supported Studio natural-language command. Use independently validated supported Scene/profile; do not claim applied.

rules.condition: Selected duration uses JSON 80.0 instead of 80
Bare V4 preset without UI outer duration or inner integer duration
Truthy preset plus non-null inner sceneJson
Outer sceneJson supplied with free text or structured prompt
rules.behavior: Prompt is not interpreted; no text-requested visual edits.

rules.condition: Outer sfx and inner sfx both present
rules.behavior: Outer object replaces all inner SFX. No field merge.

rules.condition: Pasted prompt includes cues or exportWav
rules.behavior: Existing UI always supplies only enabled/gain; pasted cues/exportWav are not sent to normalizer as selected settings.
Submission metadata, not on-screen title/glyph command.

rules.condition: Cue event missing or frame outside actual event range

rules.behavior: Absent/null auto-selects actual event chapter-start transitions; [] explicitly emits no cues.

rules.condition: Camera, territory, frontier or marker interval edit in revision prompt

rules.behavior: Does not prove GPU admission, image selection, frame output or user visual approval.

rules.condition: Access tokens, owner codes, backup encryption keys or approval values in production prompt
rules.behavior: Not supported fields; never publish or send as Scene data.

precedence: Outer non-null sceneJson skips prompt parsing.
Otherwise prompt object with exact prompt schema is structured; any other schema is treated as raw Scene.
Outer profile -> inner profile -> V4_ARCHIVAL_80S, with explicit inner mismatch rejected.
Outer duration -> inner duration -> raw plan duration, with all declared lengths required to agree.
Outer sfx if key present -> inner sfx -> defaults, replacing whole object.
Inner title -> plan.titleCandidates[0] -> plan.topic; direct outer sceneJson means inner title is not interpreted.

inputLimits.note: UI permits selecting an 8 MiB file, but backend 4 MiB serialized submission bound remains authoritative.
